environment.baseline_note: Baseline is HEAD plus shared-replay.patch; piston and wire interpreter logic unchanged. Both variants disable live output limits for deterministic offline replay.

methodology.cpu_runs: Three fresh processes per CPU per version; alternating variant order; logical processor 2; AboveNormal priority. Only tick_interpreted is timed. 50,000 ticks per run, with unchanged active windows. All frozen assertions enforced.
methodology.piston_runs: Two fresh Criterion processes per version in alternating order. Seven workloads each, 20 samples, 1-second warmup and 3-second measurement. Median of the two slope point estimates (arithmetic midpoint). Each cycle includes eight interpreted game ticks and manual power changes.
methodology.limitations: Local simulation throughput; excludes networking and rendering. Sample ranges overlap; ANPU gain is small. Shared offline replay mode bypasses live chat output limits for both versions. Bundled optimizations are measured together, not separately.

samples.assertions: whole-world checkpoints, ordered chat, per-tick Pong screen
